title: Clean a wireless earbud and replace its silicone eartip
instruction: Remove the worn eartip and put it in the discard cup. Dry-brush the speaker mesh, clean the charging contacts with the cotton swab, then fit the new eartip. Leave the earbud and tools released.
context: Wireless earbuds need periodic dry cleaning and their silicone tips wear out or must be changed for fit. The complete service procedure combines small-part removal, choosing the correct cleaning implement for each surface, controlled contact-and-sliding, and seating a compliant replacement around a narrow nozzle.
setup: One black wireless earbud (Samsung Galaxy Buds+ envelope 22.5 x 17.5 x 19.2 mm, 6.3 g) sits nozzle-forward in a low silicone service cradle on a 340 x 400 x 4 mm inspection mat; the cradle holds the shell still and leaves the nozzle and top exposed. A worn grey silicone eartip is fitted on the nozzle. Brown dry soil specks sit on the speaker mesh and on two gold charging contacts on top. A dry detail brush (100 x 40 x 32 mm rubberised handle, offset nylon bristle head) lies on a raised service-tray ledge behind the earbud, held by a light clip that lets go once the brush is gripped. A reusable electronics swab (90 x 20 x 20 mm handle, cotton tip at each end) lies beside it. A fresh pale-blue eartip stands on a small presentation peg at the lower left; a 60 mm, 25 mm deep discard cup is at the lower right. No case, liquid, putty or sharp tool.
scoring: Cleaning is recorded over the episode only while the correct tool is within a 2.5 mm contact band of its surface and sliding across it: the brush's bristle tips across the speaker mesh, and a cotton tip across the charging-contact zone. Hovering, or the wrong tool, earns nothing. At least 80% of each soil set must be cleared. End-state ladder: 0.15 for the worn tip off the nozzle and inside the discard cup; 0.40 for that plus the mesh clean; 0.60 for that plus the contacts clean; 0.85 for that plus the fresh tip caught and seated within 2 mm of the nozzle base; 1.0 for all of that with both grippers at least 4 cm from the earbud, tips and tools and every loose object at rest. Pulling the fresh tip back off loses the fit credit.
reset_notes: Refit the worn tip on the nozzle, put the fresh tip back on its peg, return the brush to its ledge and the swab to its mark, empty the discard cup, and restore the soil specks.
fidelity: Rigid-body Isaac Sim 6.1/PhysX at 20 Hz. Earbud size and mass follow Samsung's published Buds+ data; the earbud, tools and tips are compound primitives and the earbud is held fixed by its cradle. Silicone stretch is a compliant axial capture joint (catches within 6 mm and 30 deg, 0.8 mm play, about 1.5 N to pull on or off); these values are estimates, not measured. Cleaning is a one-way record of correct-tool contact plus sliding; soil specks vanish as stroke thresholds are passed.
